macos.rationale: macOS Apple Silicon and Intel supported; Linux x64 AppImage ships with each release but is experimental; Windows is not yet available. Scope: Paradev desktop, Paradev CLI and host server, Paradev iPhone app.

windows.rationale: macOS Apple Silicon and Intel supported; Linux x64 AppImage ships with each release but is experimental; Windows is not yet available. Scope: Paradev desktop, Paradev CLI and host server, Paradev iPhone app.

linux.rationale: macOS Apple Silicon and Intel supported; Linux x64 AppImage ships with each release but is experimental; Windows is not yet available. Scope: Paradev desktop, Paradev CLI and host server, Paradev iPhone app.

web-client.rationale: FAQ states there is no supported web dashboard for workspaces. Shared Pages links are readable in a browser but are not workspace control. Scope: Paradev desktop, Paradev CLI and host server, Paradev iPhone app.

ios.rationale: iPhone and iPad app is on the App Store (changelog Sep 28 2026; mobile page; install docs; FAQ) and requires iOS 26 or iPadOS 26 and Paradev Pro. Android is not available (waitlist). Push notifications are coming (FAQ) and are not claimed. Scope: Paradev desktop, Paradev CLI and host server, Paradev iPhone app.

android.rationale: iPhone and iPad app is on the App Store (changelog Sep 28 2026; mobile page; install docs; FAQ) and requires iOS 26 or iPadOS 26 and Paradev Pro. Android is not available (waitlist). Push notifications are coming (FAQ) and are not claimed. Scope: Paradev desktop, Paradev CLI and host server, Paradev iPhone app.

mobile-web.rationale: The FAQ explicitly says there is no supported web dashboard. Native iPhone/iPad and shared Pages links do not establish a phone-browser ADE client.

cli.rationale: Paradev CLI (superset command) has a standalone installer for macOS (Apple Silicon and Intel) and Linux (x64 and arm64), and manages workspaces, agents, terminals, tasks and automations. Scope: Paradev desktop, Paradev CLI and host server, Paradev iPhone app.

byo-subscription.rationale: Existing agent subscriptions are used; Superset launches agents and does not replace subscriptions. Scope: Paradev desktop.

local.rationale: Local project workspaces use git worktrees and persistent host terminals. Scope: User-provided remote host via relay, Paradev desktop, Paradev managed Cloud workspaces.

own-server.rationale: The first-party Bring Your Own Cloud guide explicitly installs the host on the user Linux cloud server. Paid Remote Access and Paradev relay/API remain required.

vendor-cloud.rationale: Team/Ultra managed cloud, connected GitHub and agent accounts required. Scope: User-provided remote host via relay, Paradev desktop, Paradev managed Cloud workspaces.

worktree.rationale: The current Paradev workspace receipt explicitly documents Git worktrees for local project workspaces. It separately describes cloud clones and scratch sessions.

vm.rationale: The pinned cloud engineering guide explicitly describes VM memory/swap and the shipped backend provisions those sandboxes. Scope is paid managed Cloud, not local worktrees.

issue-tracking.rationale: Current task and SDK documentation establishes persistent native task records with state, metadata and separate workspace dispatch; an external Linear tracker is optional. Re-attested 2026-11-07 after an independent cross-check correction to superset:PLAN-06; the cited sources were reopened and still establish this value.

unattended-triggers.rationale: RFC5545 schedules with presets; multiple triggers per automation. Scope: Paradev desktop, Paradev CLI and host server.

roles.rationale: Organization owners and device owners can delete projects; hosts have owner and member roles. Scope: User-provided remote host via relay.

sso.rationale: Enterprise lists SAML SSO. Scope: User-provided remote host via relay.

pr-workflow.rationale: Open a pull request on GitHub from the diff viewer; the Pull Requests view merges, closes and reopens the real PR (pull-requests docs; changelog Aug 23 and Oct 4). Scope: Paradev desktop.

license.rationale: Root LICENSE.md is MIT at pinned desktop-v2.0.5 commit. Scope: Pinned default-branch source.

free-tier.rationale: Free plan: 1 user, local workspaces, desktop app, CLI. Scope: Paradev desktop, Paradev managed Cloud workspaces.

starting-price.rationale: Free plan: 1 user, local workspaces, desktop app, CLI. Scope: Paradev desktop, Paradev managed Cloud workspaces.

laptop-independent.rationale: Cloud agents continue with the laptop closed; user-hosted remote work requires its host online. Scope: User-provided remote host via relay, Paradev desktop, Paradev managed Cloud workspaces.

claude-code.rationale: The cited AI Agents page lists Claude Code under Supported Agents for Paradev desktop terminal workspaces. This establishes the named harness, without implying equal status, resume or chat integration across agents.

codex.rationale: The cited AI Agents page lists Codex under Supported Agents for Paradev desktop terminal workspaces. This establishes the named harness, without implying equal status, resume or chat integration across agents.

cursor.rationale: The cited AI Agents page lists Cursor Agent under Supported Agents for Paradev desktop terminal workspaces. This establishes the named harness, without implying equal status, resume or chat integration across agents.

gemini-cli.rationale: The cited AI Agents page lists Gemini CLI under Supported Agents for Paradev desktop terminal workspaces. This establishes the named harness, without implying equal status, resume or chat integration across agents.

opencode.rationale: The cited AI Agents page lists OpenCode under Supported Agents for Paradev desktop terminal workspaces. This establishes the named harness, without implying equal status, resume or chat integration across agents.

pi.rationale: The cited AI Agents page lists Pi under Supported Agents for Paradev desktop terminal workspaces; rechecked 2026-11-10, and the desktop-v2.0.8 source ships a built-in pi agent (packages/shared/src/builtin-terminal-agents.ts). Establishes the named harness, not equal integration depth.

grok.rationale: The cited AI Agents page lists Grok (xAI Grok Build CLI) under Supported Agents; rechecked 2026-11-10, and the desktop-v2.0.8 source ships a built-in grok agent preset. Establishes the named harness, not equal integration depth.

antigravity.rationale: The pinned shipped terminal-agent registry explicitly launches Antigravity agy, with matching lifecycle hooks.

parallel-runs.rationale: The AI Agents page documents running an agent in each of several workspaces in parallel. This establishes concurrent sessions; simultaneous-agent throughput was not measured.

coordinator.rationale: The desktop app bundles superset:orchestrate. A Claude Code or Codex coordinator launches workers in separate workspaces, reads and sends terminal messages, and verifies their structured completion or blocked reports. This is documented skill-based orchestration; no delegated run was tested.

review-ui.rationale: The Paradev desktop Diff Viewer displays proposed code changes in split and unified layouts for review. This establishes an in-product review interface.

no-paid-plan.rationale: The complete Free/Pro/Team/Ultra/Enterprise offering has recurring paid plans and no one-time software purchase. Per-seat billing can also be a subscription.

subscription.rationale: The complete Free/Pro/Team/Ultra/Enterprise offering has recurring paid plans and no one-time software purchase. Per-seat billing can also be a subscription.

one-time.rationale: The complete Free/Pro/Team/Ultra/Enterprise offering has recurring paid plans and no one-time software purchase. Per-seat billing can also be a subscription.

self-hosting.rationale: The shipped roadmap explicitly establishes the core import/run/review loop signed out and offline, beyond README license permission. Scope is the complete local core on user hardware, not hosted relay/Pages/Cloud service parity.

review.note: Evidence is an MIT licence plus README permission ('self-host it'); no documented deployment of the account/sync/relay control plane on user infrastructure (README only describes a local dev stack). OWN-02 itself says hosted-service self-hosting is not established, so 'yes' overreaches.

multiplayer.rationale: The official host-sharing path plus authenticated terminal input handler lets multiple granted humans instruct the same agent terminal. Host online and plan/access restrictions remain.

telemetry-opt-out.rationale: Pinned desktop code has an always-true getter and no-op setter; the separate SDK telemetry switch does not disable main ADE desktop analytics.
